mitochondrion.name: Mitochondrion
mitochondrion.description: Double membranes, matrix, cristae and ATP synthase. Transparent envelopes expose the interior.

chloroplast.name: Chloroplast
chloroplast.description: Envelope, stroma, grana and lamellae. Light reactions occur in thylakoid membranes; the Calvin cycle occurs in the stroma.

respiratory-etc.name: Respiratory electron transport chain
respiratory-etc.description: High-proton side is the intermembrane space; ATP synthase head faces the matrix. Complex II does not pump protons.

light-reactions.name: Thylakoid light reactions
light-reactions.description: High-proton side is the thylakoid lumen; ATP synthase head and NADPH production face the stroma.
